name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=settings dialog UI, descriptor=close...with_slide). Accurately reflects behavior: closes the 2-panel settings dialog via a 4-frame inward-converge slide animation, counterpart to fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide. No address residue in the name.
purpose: Close the 2-panel settings dialog at the cursor position with a 4-frame inward-converge slide animation, then restore the backed-up dialog area and clear the keyboard buffer.
logic_summary: Plays the close-chime SFX (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle on the fdother bank, idx 8). Remembers the character under the cursor (fd2_find_char_at_cursor_pos) for restamping. Computes panel_anchor inside the large work buffer from the on-screen cursor cell (base 0x8088 + cursor_x*0x18 + cursor_y*0x2AC0). Initializes 4 corner offsets at their outer extents [-0x23A0, +0x378, +0x3A8, +0x2AC0]. Loops 4 frames: each frame moves TL/BR offsets by +0x8E8/-0x8E8 and TR/BL by +6/-6 (inward, opposite sense to open), restores the dialog area from backup, blits the 4 corner sprites at panel_anchor+offset (sprite chosen by atlas index menu_options[c]*3 + menu_state[c]*2 -> dword offset table at the dialog-state handle), restamps the saved char if any (!= -1), then flushes the dialog region to screen via fd2_blit_rectangle. After the loop, restores the dialog area once more and clears the keyboard buffer. void cdecl with __CHK(0x44) stack-probe prologue.
